name: GalaxyCon Raleigh
blurb: A four-day Raleigh festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, wrestlers, cosplayers and tattoo artists.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON RALEIGH ... July 29-August 1, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you again July 29-August 1, 2027 at the Atlantic Union Bank Convention Center ... 500 S Salisbury St Raleigh, NC 27601'

notes: Guest cards show only a name and attendance days (no bio text), so Known for is left blank throughout except #33 whose card literally adds 'WWE Icon Braun Strowman'; #34's card says only 'Kofi', expanded here to his well-known ring name Kofi Kingston (same person, not a guess). The guests page's 62 image candidates include a 7-person 'Cancellations' carousel (Danny Glover, Barry Bostwick, Matthew Lillard, plus reused photos of Eugene Cordero, Tawny Newsome, LaRue's Beehive and Soundwave) confirmed via the live page and excluded per 'skip guests marked cancelled'; the two 'Authentication' cards (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are graded-card/collectibles services, not individual guests, so they're excluded as vendor-like. #20's filename says 'DG CHICHESTER/SalvadorLarroca' but the card's own displayed name is 'Salvador Larroca', which is what's used. Four tattoo artists named on the live page (Brett Burleigh, Ed Ratcliff, Nina Bonanni, Midge O'Brien) had no image in the rendered candidate list, so they're recorded as textOnlyGuests. Cover uses the Raleigh wordmark logo since the homepage's og/hero images are a shared 11-city GalaxyCon promo graphic, a plain abstract-galaxy background, decorative cutout props, or ticket-sale banners rather than edition-specific key art.
